description: Keep rest-record integrity as a non-turning check without printing qualification telemetry to the player.

replacements.old:
<COND (<AND <EQUAL? ,HERE .OLD-HERE>
                <EQUAL? ,SCORE .OLD-SCORE>
                <EQUAL? ,SHADOW-SELF-FIRE .OLD-TIMER>
                <EQUAL? ,P-IT-OBJECT .OLD-IT>
                <EQUAL? <LOC .OBJ> .RLOC>>
           <TELL "REST-RECORD-INTEGRITY:PASS (location, score, timer, pronoun, and custody unchanged)." CR>)
          (T
           <TELL "REST-RECORD-INTEGRITY:FAIL." CR>)>
replacements.new:
<COND (<NOT <AND <EQUAL? ,HERE .OLD-HERE>
                     <EQUAL? ,SCORE .OLD-SCORE>
                     <EQUAL? ,SHADOW-SELF-FIRE .OLD-TIMER>
                     <EQUAL? ,P-IT-OBJECT .OLD-IT>
                     <EQUAL? <LOC .OBJ> .RLOC>>>
           <TELL "The notebook's account of the rest does not match the room you are still standing in." CR>)>
